scope: Project-Frankenstein agentic truthfulness routing, context budgeting/versioning, plan recitation, scratch offload, goal-scoped tool filtering, lossy context compaction, persistent task tracking and live execution traces

non_overlap_check.authority_overlap_rule: Safety/authority incidents already assigned to prior PF safety/authority receipts are not re-credited here; this shard owns attention/context/tool-surface semantics.

chronology.finding: A concrete failure was recorded: simple chat answered a self-code-analysis request without tools and fabricated a plausible nonexistent Titan timestamp bug. The fix routed self-analysis phrases into the real agentic loop and added explicit action-honesty rules forbidding pretend file reads/commands.
chronology.interpretation: Historical epistemic routing negative result: text-only cognition must not claim externally grounded observations/actions. Current Needle/FRANK routing should preserve evidence-required task detection and explicit tool/receipt provenance.

chronology.finding: The agentic loop added EMA-weighted failure scoring, compound plan risk aggregation, state auto-save, failed-attempt context versioning, dynamic context budget, and Firejail wrapping for bash/code when available. Failed contexts were tagged and summarized separately from clean successful observations.
chronology.interpretation: Direct precursor to provenance-aware context management: stale/failed hypotheses should remain retrievable but should not contaminate the active evidence surface. Dynamic budgets and cumulative risk are reusable test candidates. Firejail fallback-to-unsandboxed behavior is not a sufficient modern authority guarantee.

chronology.finding: Deep-Agents-style context engineering added update_plan as a local no-op attention tool, session scratch_write/read, automatic offload of outputs over 1500 chars, goal-classified tool filtering with at most 15 shown tools, and a permissive legacy <tool> tag fallback parser. Context tools bypassed the normal executor.
chronology.interpretation: Plan recitation and tool-surface filtering are attention-control mechanisms, not execution authority. Scratch offload is reusable only if the full source remains addressable. Flexible legacy tool parsing must sit before deterministic schema/capability validation, never replace it.

chronology.finding: Projects added context compaction above ~40K estimated tokens, truncating older tool results/text while keeping the last three exchanges full; persistent task_write/task_list JSON records; SSE live tool/result/text events; and increased the agent loop from 15 to 25 iterations. The commit explicitly states API credits prevented end-to-end live testing at that point.
chronology.interpretation: Gradient context and persistent task ledgers are useful, but destructive/lossy compaction without immutable source references is not replay-safe. Live observability does not confer authorization. Increased iteration depth expands failure/effect accumulation and needs explicit budgets/checkpoints.

negative_results_constraints.claim: A text-only/chat route must not report file/code/system findings as observed facts when no corresponding tool/evidence receipt exists.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: A reproducible mechanism provides the same grounded evidence without external observation/tool execution and exposes verifiable provenance.

negative_results_constraints.claim: Goal-scoped tool filtering reduces cognitive/action-space load but is not a security or capability boundary.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: A formally enforced tool-surface mechanism proves hidden tools are unreachable at the executor/capability layer rather than merely absent from the prompt.

negative_results_constraints.claim: Lossy context compaction that replaces old evidence without a content-addressed source handle is insufficient for replay, audit and contradiction recovery.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: Replay tests show bit-/semantics-equivalent causal reconstruction from compacted state alone across adversarial long-horizon cases.

negative_results_constraints.claim: Plan recitation improves attention continuity but plan text is not an authoritative task-state transition or execution grant.
Permissive fallback parsing of model-generated tool tags must not directly authorize effects; parsed output requires deterministic typed validation and capability checks.
Increasing autonomous loop depth without cumulative risk/failure budgets, cancellation and checkpoints can increase consequence radius even when each individual action appears bounded.

reusable_candidates.mechanism: persistent task ledger + SSE execution trace

architecture_delta.recommended_testable_shape: Needle/task router selects a small cognitive tool surface -> model proposes typed ClayCode action/plan -> deterministic validator resolves schema + capability + budget -> executor produces immutable evidence/effect receipt -> large evidence may be summarized in active context only by retaining content-addressed source handles -> failed attempts remain versioned retrievable evidence, not silently discarded.

branch_feedback.frank: DELTA: preserve action honesty as a first-class self/world-model invariant. Claims of inspection/action should require linked observation/effect receipts. Preserve cancellation and cumulative failure/risk accounting across long autonomous loops.
branch_feedback.harness: DELTA: benchmark dynamic context budgets, plan checkpoints and goal-scoped tool surfaces, but enforce capabilities independently. Add immutable evidence handles before any scratch/compaction summary and test replay after aggressive compaction.
branch_feedback.claycode: DELTA: model plans/tool tags should compile into typed transition proposals. Legacy permissive parsers may normalize syntax but cannot grant authority; capability/budget/provenance validation remains external and deterministic.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: DELTA: store full tool results/evidence content-addressably, active-context summaries as derived views, versioned failed-attempt branches, persistent task states, and effect/outcome receipts. Compaction must never erase the durable object.
branch_feedback.claygraph: DELTA: failed-attempt and successful-observation branches should remain distinguishable in activation/retrieval so stale failures can inform without contaminating current fact status.
branch_feedback.gwt: DELTA: small goal-relevant candidate/tool surfaces can be tested as competition-input shaping, while global availability must retain provenance links to the original evidence.
branch_feedback.emergenz: NO_CHANGE to emergence claims; longer autonomous loops and plan recitation are not emergence evidence without causal lesion/rescue tests.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: DELTA: unresolved candidate actions/evidence branches can remain set-valued until validation commits one transition; prompt filtering must not silently delete alternatives from durable state.
branch_feedback.clay: DELTA: module dissolution should preserve semantic separation of attention shaping, evidence persistence and effect authority even if implemented in one runtime.
branch_feedback.q12_index: DELTA: context-engineering lineage is historically reusable but receives no new hour credit until row-level deduplication.
